newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian state has bids for food canners.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian state has bids for food canners.

text.p: The Egyptian state's Holding Company for Food Industries has received six bids to buy into two food canning companies -- Edfina for Preserved Foods and Kaha Preserved Foods, a company official said on Wednesday.
The state has offered to sell up to 90 percent of each company as part of the government's privatisation programme.
The holding company department dealing with privatisation said the bids came from Egyptian and Arab companies and broke them down as follows:
-- one bid to buy all of Kaha
-- one bid to buy both Kaha and Edfina
-- one bid to buy four of Kaha's plants
-- two bids to buy one of Kaha's plants
-- one bid, from a Saudi company, to buy either Edfina alone or Edfina and Kaha together.

An official at the holding company said it would take about three weeks to study the technical bids and the company would then set a date for opening the separate price bids. A sale could take place in about a month and half, he added.
Under the conditions for sale, the buyers must continue to carry out the same activity, invest money in the companies and keeps the workforce for at least three years.
The holding company offered Edfina in January and Kaha in April, both to strategic investors or groups of investors.
The state has found the search for anchor investors much more difficult than selling profitable companies by flotations through the stock exchange.
